svg.title: pump-bot — trading bots for pump.fun on Solana
svg.desc: Animated banner for pump-bot, open-source research bots for pump.fun on Solana. A new token's price rises along a bonding curve; the bot's configurable entry band lights up and the bot buys inside it; at 100% (≈ 85 SOL) the token graduates to a PumpSwap pool where the price often falls; the bot exits by take-profit, stop-loss or timeout. Dry-run by default; a research tool, not financial advice, profit not guaranteed.
svg.text: a research tool · not financial advice · profit not guaranteed
